findings.title: HPA cannot read its metrics
findings.cause: HPA web cannot read resource metrics for Deployment web, because the metrics API (metrics-server) is not answering, so the HPA does not scale

evidence.detail: the HPA was unable to compute the replica count: failed to get cpu utilization: unable to get metrics for resource cpu: unable to fetch metrics from resource metrics API: the server could not find the requested resource (get pods.metrics.k8s.io)

findings.fix: Install metrics-server (or the cluster's metrics adapter) and check that the v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io APIService is Available.
